flowElements.headingText: Line 23, credit for low-income workers and families:
flowElements.rawXml:
Line 23, credit for low-income workers and families:

No credit is claimed on this return.

Refundable Virginia Earned Income Credit:

15% of the earned income credit on your federal return. Virginia pays it even when it is more than your tax, so it can become a refund.

Virginia Earned Income Credit:

20% of the earned income credit on your federal return, up to your Virginia tax. That was worth more than the refundable 15% ( ).

Credit for Low-Income Individuals:

$300 for each person in your household, because your family's Virginia adjusted gross income is at or under the poverty guideline for its size. Up to your Virginia tax.

To claim it, your return gives up your age deduction. The credit lowers your tax more.

To claim it, your return gives up your exemption for being 65 or older or blind. The credit lowers your tax more.

To claim it, your return gives up your military basic pay subtraction. The credit lowers your tax more.

You did not have to ask for this. Virginia's three credits for people with low incomes come from your federal return; the return claims the one worth the most to you, as Form 760 asks (Schedule ADJ, Lines 10 to 17).

You could claim in Virginia's credit for low-income workers and families, but only by giving up your age deduction, your 65 or older or blind exemption, or your military basic pay subtraction. Keeping them lowers your tax more, so your return keeps them.

facts.name: Earned income credit (EITC)
facts.description: Earned income credit (EITC) (line 27 1040) We calculate the EITC up to four times -- EITC may be calculated with: 1. No combat pay (for people without combat pay, and people who elect not to include their combat pay) 2. With the primary filer's combat pay 3. With the secondary filer's combat pay 4. With both filer's combined combat pay. If a user qualifies for more than 1 of those options (most taxpayers do not have combat pay and will therefore default into the "no combat pay" option), we guide the taxpayer towards electing the combat pay option that will give them the most EITC.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/earnedIncomeCredit">
  <Name>Earned income credit (EITC)</Name>
  <Description>Earned income credit (EITC) (line 27 1040)

        We calculate the EITC up to four times -- EITC may be
        calculated with:
        1. No combat pay (for people without combat pay, and people who elect not to include their
        combat pay)
        2. With the primary filer's combat pay
        3. With the secondary filer's combat pay
        4. With both filer's
        combined combat pay.

        If a user qualifies for more than 1 of those options (most taxpayers do not have combat pay
        and will therefore default into the "no combat pay" option), we guide the taxpayer towards electing the combat
        pay option that will give them the most EITC.</Description>
  <Export downstreamFacts="true" mef="true"/>
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency path="/eitcQualified"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Switch>
            <Case>
              <When>
                <All>
                  <Dependency module="formW2s" path="/someFilerHasCombatPay"/>
                  <Equal>
                    <Left>
                      <Dependency path="/combatPayElectionAndOrRecommendation"/>
                    </Left>
                    <Right>
                      <Enum optionsPath="/combatPayOptions">usePrimaryCombatPay</Enum>
                    </Right>
                  </Equal>
                </All>
              </When>
              <Then>
                <Dependency path="/eitcAmountWithPrimaryCombatPay"/>
              </Then>
            </Case>
            <Case>
              <When>
                <All>
                  <Dependency module="formW2s" path="/someFilerHasCombatPay"/>
                  <Equal>
                    <Left>
                      <Dependency path="/combatPayElectionAndOrRecommendation"/>
                    </Left>
                    <Right>
                      <Enum optionsPath="/combatPayOptions">useSpouseCombatPay</Enum>
                    </Right>
                  </Equal>
                </All>
              </When>
              <Then>
                <Dependency path="/eitcAmountWithSecondaryCombatPay"/>
              </Then>
            </Case>
            <Case>
              <When>
                <All>
                  <Dependency module="formW2s" path="/someFilerHasCombatPay"/>
                  <Equal>
                    <Left>
                      <Dependency path="/combatPayElectionAndOrRecommendation"/>
                    </Left>
                    <Right>
                      <Enum optionsPath="/combatPayOptions">useBothCombatPay</Enum>
                    </Right>
                  </Equal>
                </All>
              </When>
              <Then>
                <Dependency path="/eitcAmountWithBothTPCombatPay"/>
              </Then>
            </Case>
            <Case>
              <When>
                <All>
                  <Dependency module="formW2s" path="/someFilerHasCombatPay"/>
                  <Equal>
                    <Left>
                      <Dependency path="/combatPayElectionAndOrRecommendation"/>
                    </Left>
                    <Right>
                      <Enum optionsPath="/combatPayOptions">usePrimaryNotSpouseCombatPay</Enum>
                    </Right>
                  </Equal>
                </All>
              </When>
              <Then>
                <Dependency path="/eitcAmountWithPrimaryCombatPay"/>
              </Then>
            </Case>
            <Case>
              <When>
                <All>
                  <Dependency module="formW2s" path="/someFilerHasCombatPay"/>
                  <Equal>
                    <Left>
                      <Dependency path="/combatPayElectionAndOrRecommendation"/>
                    </Left>
                    <Right>
                      <Enum optionsPath="/combatPayOptions">useSpouseNotPrimaryCombatPay</Enum>
                    </Right>
                  </Equal>
                </All>
              </When>
              <Then>
                <Dependency path="/eitcAmountWithSecondaryCombatPay"/>
              </Then>
            </Case>
            <Case>
              <When>
                <True/>
              </When>
              <Then>
                <Dependency path="/eitcAmountWithoutCombatPay"/>
              </Then>
            </Case>
          </Switch>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <True/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dollar>0</Dollar>
        </Then>
      </Case>
    </Switch>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Credit for Low-Income Individuals, per exemption
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-339.8(B)(1): $300 each for the individual, the spouse and each dependent. 2024 Form 760 instructions, Schedule ADJ Line 13.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaLowIncomeCreditPerExemption">
  <Name>Credit for Low-Income Individuals, per exemption</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-339.8(B)(1): $300 each for the individual, the spouse and each dependent. 2024
        Form 760 instructions, Schedule ADJ Line 13.</Description>
  <TaxYear>2024</TaxYear>
  <Derived>
    <Dollar>300</Dollar>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Poverty guideline, a family of one
facts.description: 2024 Form 760 instructions, Schedule ADJ Line 11, Poverty Guideline Table: $15,060 for one eligible exemption (the 2024 federal poverty guideline).
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaPovertyGuidelineFirstPerson">
  <Name>Poverty guideline, a family of one</Name>
  <Description>2024 Form 760 instructions, Schedule ADJ Line 11, Poverty Guideline Table:
        $15,060 for one eligible exemption (the 2024 federal poverty guideline).</Description>
  <TaxYear>2024</TaxYear>
  <Derived>
    <Dollar>15060</Dollar>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Poverty guideline, each additional family member
facts.description: 2024 Form 760 instructions, Poverty Guideline Table: $5,380 for each additional person, spouse and dependent exemption ($20,440 for two, $52,720 for eight).
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaPovertyGuidelineEachAdditionalPerson">
  <Name>Poverty guideline, each additional family member</Name>
  <Description>2024 Form 760 instructions, Poverty Guideline Table: $5,380 for each additional
        person, spouse and dependent exemption ($20,440 for two, $52,720 for eight).</Description>
  <TaxYear>2024</TaxYear>
  <Derived>
    <Dollar>5380</Dollar>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Virginia Earned Income Credit rate, nonrefundable
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-339.8(B)(2): 20% of the federal earned income credit, in place of the Credit for Low-Income Individuals. 2024 Form 760 instructions, Schedule ADJ Line 15.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaEarnedIncomeCreditRate">
  <Name>Virginia Earned Income Credit rate, nonrefundable</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-339.8(B)(2): 20% of the federal earned income credit, in place of the
        Credit for Low-Income Individuals. 2024 Form 760
        instructions, Schedule ADJ Line 15.</Description>
  <TaxYear>2024</TaxYear>
  <Derived>
    <Rational>20/100</Rational>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Refundable Virginia Earned Income Credit rate
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-339.8(B)(3)(a): for taxable years 2022 through 2024, 15% of the federal earned income credit, refundable, in place of either nonrefundable credit (20% from 2025, subdivision 3 b). 2024 Form 760 instructions, Schedule ADJ Line 16b.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaRefundableEarnedIncomeCreditRate">
  <Name>Refundable Virginia Earned Income Credit rate</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-339.8(B)(3)(a): for taxable years 2022 through 2024, 15% of the federal
        earned income credit, refundable, in place of either nonrefundable credit (20% from 2025,
        subdivision 3 b). 2024 Form 760
        instructions, Schedule ADJ Line 16b.</Description>
  <TaxYear>2024</TaxYear>
  <Derived>
    <Rational>15/100</Rational>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Not barred from the low-income credits outright
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-339.8(B)(1) and the 2024 Schedule ADJ eligibility requirements: no credit for a filer claimed as a dependent on another return. The other bars (the age deduction, the 65 or older and blind exemptions, military basic pay, claimed by the filer or the spouse) are elections, weighed in /vaClaimsLowIncomeCredit. The National Guard and federal and state employee subtractions (codes 28 and 39) are out of scope, as is anything a dependent claims.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaCanClaimLowIncomeCredit">
  <Name>Not barred from the low-income credits outright</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-339.8(B)(1) and the 2024 Schedule ADJ eligibility requirements: no
        credit for a filer claimed as a dependent on another return. The other bars (the age
        deduction, the 65 or older and blind exemptions, military basic pay, claimed by the filer or
        the spouse) are elections, weighed in /vaClaimsLowIncomeCredit. The National Guard and
        federal and state employee subtractions (codes 28 and 39) are out of scope, as is anything a
        dependent claims.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Not>
      <Dependency module="filers" path="/primaryFiler/canBeClaimed"/>
    </Not>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Schedule ADJ Line 11, poverty guideline for the family size
facts.description: 2024 Poverty Guideline Table: $15,060 for one, plus $5,380 for each more person. Family size is the You, Spouse and Dependents count (/vaPersonalExemptionCount).
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaPovertyGuideline">
  <Name>Schedule ADJ Line 11, poverty guideline for the family size</Name>
  <Description>2024 Poverty Guideline Table: $15,060 for one, plus $5,380 for each more person.
        Family size is the You, Spouse and Dependents count (/vaPersonalExemptionCount).</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Add>
      <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaPovertyGuidelineFirstPerson"/>
      <Multiply>
        <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaPovertyGuidelineEachAdditionalPerson"/>
        <Subtract>
          <Minuend>
            <Dependency module="virginiaDeductions" path="/vaPersonalExemptionCount"/>
          </Minuend>
          <Subtrahends>
            <Int>1</Int>
          </Subtrahends>
        </Subtract>
      </Multiply>
    </Add>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Family VAGI at or under the poverty guideline
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-339.8(B)(1). Family VAGI (Schedule ADJ Line 10) is the return's Virginia AGI with no age deduction or basic pay subtraction; a dependent's own income is not on the federal return, so it is taken as $0 here.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaQualifiesForCreditForLowIncomeIndividuals">
  <Name>Family VAGI at or under the poverty guideline</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-339.8(B)(1). Family VAGI (Schedule ADJ Line 10) is the return's
        Virginia AGI with no age deduction or basic pay subtraction; a dependent's own income is not
        on the federal return, so it is taken as $0 here.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <All>
      <Dependency path="/vaCanClaimLowIncomeCredit"/>
      <LessThanOrEqual>
        <Left>
          <Dependency module="virginiaIncome" path="/vaWithCreditAdjustedGrossIncome"/>
        </Left>
        <Right>
          <Dependency path="/vaPovertyGuideline"/>
        </Right>
      </LessThanOrEqual>
    </All>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Schedule ADJ Line 13, Credit for Low-Income Individuals
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-339.8(B)(1): $300 times the personal and dependent exemptions (Schedule ADJ Line 12; not the 65 or older or blind ones), if the family qualifies.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaCreditForLowIncomeIndividuals">
  <Name>Schedule ADJ Line 13, Credit for Low-Income Individuals</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-339.8(B)(1): $300 times the personal and dependent exemptions
        (Schedule ADJ Line 12; not the 65 or older or blind ones), if the family qualifies.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency path="/vaQualifiesForCreditForLowIncomeIndividuals"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Multiply>
            <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaLowIncomeCreditPerExemption"/>
            <Dependency module="virginiaDeductions" path="/vaPersonalExemptionCount"/>
          </Multiply>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <True/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dollar>0</Dollar>
        </Then>
      </Case>
    </Switch>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Schedule ADJ Line 14, federal earned income credit
facts.description: Read from the federal return (/earnedIncomeCredit, exported to MeF as Form 1040 line 27). $0 for a filer claimed as a dependent.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaFederalEarnedIncomeCredit">
  <Name>Schedule ADJ Line 14, federal earned income credit</Name>
  <Description>Read from the federal return (/earnedIncomeCredit, exported to MeF as Form 1040
        line 27). $0 for a filer claimed as a dependent.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency path="/vaCanClaimLowIncomeCredit"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dependency module="eitc" path="/earnedIncomeCredit"/>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <True/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dollar>0</Dollar>
        </Then>
      </Case>
    </Switch>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Schedule ADJ Line 15, Virginia Earned Income Credit
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-339.8(B)(2): 20% of Line 14, rounded to the dollar.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaEarnedIncomeCredit">
  <Name>Schedule ADJ Line 15, Virginia Earned Income Credit</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-339.8(B)(2): 20% of Line 14, rounded to the dollar.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Round>
      <Multiply>
        <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaEarnedIncomeCreditRate"/>
        <Dependency path="/vaFederalEarnedIncomeCredit"/>
      </Multiply>
    </Round>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Schedule ADJ Line 16a, the greater of Line 13 or Line 15
facts.description: Schedule ADJ Line 16a: the greater of Line 13 (the Credit for Low-Income Individuals) and Line 15 (the nonrefundable Virginia Earned Income Credit), § 58.1-339.8; the schedule claims one, not both.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaGreaterNonrefundableCredit">
  <Name>Schedule ADJ Line 16a, the greater of Line 13 or Line 15</Name>
  <Description>Schedule ADJ Line 16a: the greater of Line 13 (the Credit for Low-Income Individuals) and Line 15 (the nonrefundable Virginia Earned Income Credit), § 58.1-339.8; the schedule claims one, not both.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <GreaterOf>
      <Dependency path="/vaCreditForLowIncomeIndividuals"/>
      <Dependency path="/vaEarnedIncomeCredit"/>
    </GreaterOf>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Schedule ADJ Line 16b, Refundable Virginia Earned Income Credit
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-339.8(B)(3)(a): 15% of Line 14, rounded to the dollar.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaRefundableEarnedIncomeCredit">
  <Name>Schedule ADJ Line 16b, Refundable Virginia Earned Income Credit</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-339.8(B)(3)(a): 15% of Line 14, rounded to the dollar.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Round>
      <Multiply>
        <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaRefundableEarnedIncomeCreditRate"/>
        <Dependency path="/vaFederalEarnedIncomeCredit"/>
      </Multiply>
    </Round>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Line 16a, limited to the tax
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-339.8(C): a nonrefundable credit cannot exceed the tax (Line 18, here the tax on the return that claims the credit).
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaNonrefundableCreditUsable">
  <Name>Line 16a, limited to the tax</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-339.8(C): a nonrefundable credit cannot exceed the tax (Line 18,
        here the tax on the return that claims the credit).</Description>
  <Derived>
    <LesserOf>
      <Dependency path="/vaGreaterNonrefundableCredit"/>
      <Dependency module="virginiaTax" path="/vaWithCreditTax"/>
    </LesserOf>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: The refundable credit is worth more than the nonrefundable one
facts.description: 2024 Schedule ADJ Line 17: "Choose the credit option that benefits you the most."
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaCreditIsRefundable">
  <Name>The refundable credit is worth more than the nonrefundable one</Name>
  <Description>2024 Schedule ADJ Line 17: "Choose the credit option that benefits you the most."</Description>
  <Derived>
    <GreaterThan>
      <Left>
        <Dependency path="/vaRefundableEarnedIncomeCredit"/>
      </Left>
      <Right>
        <Dependency path="/vaNonrefundableCreditUsable"/>
      </Right>
    </GreaterThan>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Schedule ADJ Line 17, the credit that benefits the filer most
facts.description: The lesser of Line 16a and the tax, or Line 16b, whichever is greater.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaBestLowIncomeCredit">
  <Name>Schedule ADJ Line 17, the credit that benefits the filer most</Name>
  <Description>The lesser of Line 16a and the tax, or Line 16b, whichever is greater.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <GreaterOf>
      <Dependency path="/vaNonrefundableCreditUsable"/>
      <Dependency path="/vaRefundableEarnedIncomeCredit"/>
    </GreaterOf>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Tax less the credit, if the return claims a low-income credit
facts.description: Negative when the refundable credit exceeds the tax.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaWithCreditTaxAfterCredit">
  <Name>Tax less the credit, if the return claims a low-income credit</Name>
  <Description>Negative when the refundable credit exceeds the tax.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Subtract>
      <Minuend>
        <Dependency module="virginiaTax" path="/vaWithCreditTax"/>
      </Minuend>
      <Subtrahends>
        <Dependency path="/vaBestLowIncomeCredit"/>
      </Subtrahends>
    </Subtract>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: The return claims a low-income credit
facts.description: The election Form 760 leaves to the filer: the instructions for Line 4 say to "claim the deduction or subtraction that gives you the greatest tax benefit." The return claims a credit when there is one and the tax less the credit is lower than the tax keeping everything Va. Code § 58.1-339.8(D) says the filer, the spouse or both would give up: the age deduction of either spouse, the 65 or older and blind exemptions of either spouse, and the military basic pay subtraction. Withholding, payments and use tax are the same either way, so this is the whole comparison.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaClaimsLowIncomeCredit">
  <Name>The return claims a low-income credit</Name>
  <Description>The election Form 760 leaves to the filer: the instructions for Line 4 say to
        "claim the deduction or subtraction that gives you the greatest tax benefit." The return
        claims a credit when there is one and the tax less the credit is lower than the tax keeping
        everything Va. Code § 58.1-339.8(D) says the filer, the spouse or both would give up: the age
        deduction of either spouse, the 65 or older and blind exemptions of either spouse, and the
        military basic pay subtraction. Withholding, payments and use tax are the same either way, so
        this is the whole comparison.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <All>
      <GreaterThan>
        <Left>
          <Dependency path="/vaBestLowIncomeCredit"/>
        </Left>
        <Right>
          <Dollar>0</Dollar>
        </Right>
      </GreaterThan>
      <LessThan>
        <Left>
          <Dependency path="/vaWithCreditTaxAfterCredit"/>
        </Left>
        <Right>
          <Dependency module="virginiaTax" path="/vaWithoutCreditTax"/>
        </Right>
      </LessThan>
    </All>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Form 760 Line 23, Credit for Low-Income Individuals or Virginia Earned Income Credit
facts.description: Schedule ADJ Line 17 when the return claims it; otherwise $0.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaLowIncomeCredit">
  <Name>Form 760 Line 23, Credit for Low-Income Individuals or Virginia Earned Income Credit</Name>
  <Description>Schedule ADJ Line 17 when the return claims it; otherwise $0.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency path="/vaClaimsLowIncomeCredit"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dependency path="/vaBestLowIncomeCredit"/>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <True/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dollar>0</Dollar>
        </Then>
      </Case>
    </Switch>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Line 23 is the Refundable Virginia Earned Income Credit
facts.description: Which credit Line 23 is, for the summary's words: the refundable Virginia Earned Income Credit (Schedule ADJ Line 16b, § 58.1-339.8), when the return claims a low-income credit and /vaCreditIsRefundable chose the refundable one.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaClaimsRefundableEarnedIncomeCredit">
  <Name>Line 23 is the Refundable Virginia Earned Income Credit</Name>
  <Description>Which credit Line 23 is, for the summary's words: the refundable Virginia Earned Income Credit (Schedule ADJ Line 16b, § 58.1-339.8), when the return claims a low-income credit and /vaCreditIsRefundable chose the refundable one.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <All>
      <Dependency path="/vaClaimsLowIncomeCredit"/>
      <Dependency path="/vaCreditIsRefundable"/>
    </All>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Line 23 is the Credit for Low-Income Individuals
facts.description: Line 16a is Line 13 when Line 13 is at least Line 15.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaClaimsCreditForLowIncomeIndividuals">
  <Name>Line 23 is the Credit for Low-Income Individuals</Name>
  <Description>Line 16a is Line 13 when Line 13 is at least Line 15.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <All>
      <Dependency path="/vaClaimsLowIncomeCredit"/>
      <Not>
        <Dependency path="/vaCreditIsRefundable"/>
      </Not>
      <GreaterThanOrEqual>
        <Left>
          <Dependency path="/vaCreditForLowIncomeIndividuals"/>
        </Left>
        <Right>
          <Dependency path="/vaEarnedIncomeCredit"/>
        </Right>
      </GreaterThanOrEqual>
    </All>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Line 23 is the nonrefundable Virginia Earned Income Credit
facts.description: Which credit Line 23 is, for the summary's words: the nonrefundable Virginia Earned Income Credit (Schedule ADJ Line 15, § 58.1-339.8), when the return claims a low-income credit, the refundable one is not worth more, and Line 15 beats Line 13.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaClaimsNonrefundableEarnedIncomeCredit">
  <Name>Line 23 is the nonrefundable Virginia Earned Income Credit</Name>
  <Description>Which credit Line 23 is, for the summary's words: the nonrefundable Virginia Earned Income Credit (Schedule ADJ Line 15, § 58.1-339.8), when the return claims a low-income credit, the refundable one is not worth more, and Line 15 beats Line 13.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <All>
      <Dependency path="/vaClaimsLowIncomeCredit"/>
      <Not>
        <Dependency path="/vaCreditIsRefundable"/>
      </Not>
      <Not>
        <Dependency path="/vaClaimsCreditForLowIncomeIndividuals"/>
      </Not>
    </All>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Claiming the credit gave up the age deduction
facts.description: Shown on the summary, so the filer sees what the credit replaced and what it was worth; on a joint return the figure includes the spouse's deduction.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaCreditReplacedAgeDeduction">
  <Name>Claiming the credit gave up the age deduction</Name>
  <Description>Shown on the summary, so the filer sees what the credit replaced and what it was
        worth; on a joint return the figure includes the spouse's deduction.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <All>
      <Dependency path="/vaClaimsLowIncomeCredit"/>
      <GreaterThan>
        <Left>
          <Dependency module="virginiaIncome" path="/vaAgeDeductionAllowed"/>
        </Left>
        <Right>
          <Dollar>0</Dollar>
        </Right>
      </GreaterThan>
    </All>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: A credit was available, but keeping the deductions saves more
facts.description: For the summary: a low-income credit was available (Schedule ADJ Line 17 above zero) but the return keeps the age deduction, the 65-or-older and blind exemptions and the military basic pay subtraction the credit would bar (§ 58.1-339.8(D)), because they save more. Computes no line.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaCreditDeclinedForADeduction">
  <Name>A credit was available, but keeping the deductions saves more</Name>
  <Description>For the summary: a low-income credit was available (Schedule ADJ Line 17 above zero) but the return keeps the age deduction, the 65-or-older and blind exemptions and the military basic pay subtraction the credit would bar (§ 58.1-339.8(D)), because they save more. Computes no line.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <All>
      <Not>
        <Dependency path="/vaClaimsLowIncomeCredit"/>
      </Not>
      <GreaterThan>
        <Left>
          <Dependency path="/vaBestLowIncomeCredit"/>
        </Left>
        <Right>
          <Dollar>0</Dollar>
        </Right>
      </GreaterThan>
    </All>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Exemptions claimed in the You, Spouse and Dependents boxes
facts.description: 2024 Form 760 instructions, Exemptions Section A: yourself, your spouse on a joint return, and the dependents claimed federally, counted from each household member's isClaimedDependent, which the federal return exports to states. (The federal /claimedDependentsCount is not exported, so it is not read.)
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaPersonalExemptionCount">
  <Name>Exemptions claimed in the You, Spouse and Dependents boxes</Name>
  <Description>2024 Form 760 instructions, Exemptions Section A: yourself, your spouse on a
        joint return, and the dependents claimed federally, counted from each household member's
        isClaimedDependent, which the federal return exports to states. (The federal
        /claimedDependentsCount is not exported, so it is not read.)</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Add>
      <Int>1</Int>
      <Switch>
        <Case>
          <When>
            <Dependency module="virginiaFiler" path="/vaIsFilingStatus2"/>
          </When>
          <Then>
            <Int>1</Int>
          </Then>
        </Case>
        <Case>
          <When>
            <True/>
          </When>
          <Then>
            <Int>0</Int>
          </Then>
        </Case>
      </Switch>
      <Count>
        <Dependency module="familyAndHousehold" path="/familyAndHousehold/*/isClaimedDependent"/>
      </Count>
    </Add>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Exemptions, Section B amount the filers qualify for
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(2)(b): $800 times the 65 or older and Blind count, the spouse's boxes included. 2024 Form 760 instructions, Exemptions: these cannot be claimed with a Credit for Low-Income Individuals on Line 23 (Va. Code § 58.1-339.8(D)(4) bars every low-income credit when the filer or the spouse claims one).
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaAgedOrBlindExemptionsAllowed">
  <Name>Exemptions, Section B amount the filers qualify for</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(2)(b): $800 times the 65 or older and Blind count, the
        spouse's boxes included. 2024 Form 760 instructions, Exemptions: these cannot be claimed with
        a Credit for Low-Income Individuals on Line 23 (Va. Code § 58.1-339.8(D)(4) bars every
        low-income credit when the filer or the spouse claims one).</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Multiply>
      <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaAgedOrBlindExemptionAmount"/>
      <Dependency path="/vaAgedOrBlindExemptionCount"/>
    </Multiply>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Form 760 Line 12, exemptions

facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaExemptions">

        </When>

</Fact>

facts.name: Form 760 Line 4, age deduction
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-339.8(D)(5): a return on which the filer or the spouse claims the age deduction cannot claim the Credit for Low-Income Individuals or either Virginia Earned Income Credit. The age deduction the return qualifies for, or $0 when the return claims one of those credits instead.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaAgeDeduction">
  <Name>Form 760 Line 4, age deduction</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-339.8(D)(5): a return on which the filer or the spouse claims the age
        deduction cannot claim the Credit for Low-Income Individuals or either Virginia Earned Income
        Credit. The age deduction the return qualifies for, or $0 when the return claims one of those
        credits instead.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency module="virginiaCredits" path="/vaClaimsLowIncomeCredit"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dollar>0</Dollar>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <True/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dependency path="/vaAgeDeductionAllowed"/>
        </Then>

    </Switch>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Military basic pay subtraction the filer qualifies for (Schedule ADJ code 38)
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-322.02(15): all basic pay up to $15,000; above that, $15,000 reduced dollar for dollar by the pay over $15,000, so nothing at $30,000 or more. Limited to what federal AGI includes, here W-2 wages. The cap is the household's /wages (exported to MeF): the federal per-filer figures (/primaryFilerWages, /formW2s/*/filer, /formW2s/*/belongsToPrimaryFiler) are not exported to states, so the primary filer's own wages cannot be read here; on a joint return the cap is therefore loose by the spouse's wages. Claimed on Line 7 only if the return does not claim a low-income credit (Va. Code § 58.1-339.8(D)(2)).
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaMilitaryBasicPaySubtractionAllowed">
  <Name>Military basic pay subtraction the filer qualifies for (Schedule ADJ code 38)</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-322.02(15): all basic pay up to $15,000; above that, $15,000
        reduced dollar for dollar by the pay over $15,000, so nothing at $30,000 or more. Limited to
        what federal AGI includes, here W-2 wages. The cap is the household's /wages (exported to
        MeF): the federal per-filer figures (/primaryFilerWages, /formW2s/*/filer,
        /formW2s/*/belongsToPrimaryFiler) are not exported to states, so the primary filer's own
        wages cannot be read here; on a joint return the cap is therefore loose by the spouse's
        wages. Claimed on Line 7 only if the return does not claim a low-income credit (Va. Code
        § 58.1-339.8(D)(2)).</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Not>
            <Dependency path="/vaHasMilitaryIncome"/>
          </Not>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dollar>0</Dollar>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Not>
            <Dependency path="/vaHasMilitaryBasicPay"/>
          </Not>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dollar>0</Dollar>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <LessThanOrEqual>
            <Left>
              <Dependency path="/vaMilitaryBasicPay"/>
            </Left>
            <Right>
              <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaMilitaryBasicPayMaximum"/>
            </Right>
          </LessThanOrEqual>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <LesserOf>
            <Dependency path="/vaMilitaryBasicPay"/>
            <Dependency module="formW2s" path="/wages"/>
          </LesserOf>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <True/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <LesserOf>
            <Dependency module="formW2s" path="/wages"/>
            <Dependency path="/vaMilitaryBasicPayPhasedOut"/>
          </LesserOf>
        </Then>
      </Case>
    </Switch>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

  <Name>Virginia adjusted gross income below the filing threshold</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-321(A); 2024 Form 760 instructions, Line 9: if Line 9 is less

        the without-credit test, whichever way the return files.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency module="virginiaCredits" path="/vaClaimsLowIncomeCredit"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dependency path="/vaWithCreditIsBelowFilingThreshold"/>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <True/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dependency path="/vaWithoutCreditIsBelowFilingThreshold"/>
